@@ -149,1 +149,70 @@
-# first two helper functions...
+_HEAP_MIN_LEN = 64
+
+def _apply_merges_heap(ids, merges):
+    """
+    apply_merges for long sequences: same rounds (merge every occurrence of the
+    minimal-rank pair found first, left to right, non-overlapping), but the
+    minimal rank is found with a heap of (rank, position, left, right) entries
+    over a linked list of nodes instead of rescanning a rank list per round.
+    Positions are original indices, so heap order = sequence order on ties.
+    Stale heap entries are dropped lazily when popped.
+    """
+    merges_get = merges.get
+    tok = list(ids) # tok[i] is None once node i has been merged into its left neighbour
+    n = len(tok)
+    nxt = list(range(1, n + 1))
+    nxt[-1] = -1
+    prv = list(range(-1, n - 1))
+    pairs = list(zip(tok, tok[1:]))
+    heap = [(r, i) + p for i, (p, r) in enumerate(zip(pairs, map(merges_get, pairs)))
+            if r is not None]
+    heapify(heap)
+    while heap:
+        r = heap[0][0]
+        cand = []
+        while heap and heap[0][0] == r:
+            _, i, a, b = heappop(heap)
+            j = nxt[i]
+            if j >= 0 and tok[i] == a and tok[j] == b:
+                cand.append(i)
+        if not cand:
+            continue
+        if len(cand) > 1:
+            cand = sorted(set(cand))
+        i = cand[0]
+        p0 = tok[i]
+        p1 = tok[nxt[i]]
+        merged = []
+        for i in cand:
+            t = tok[i]
+            if t is None:
+                continue # right half of an overlapping occurrence merged just before
+            j = nxt[i]
+            u = tok[j]
+            if t != p0 or u != p1:
+                # another pair with the same rank: left for a later round
+                heappush(heap, (r, i, t, u))
+                continue
+            tok[i] = r
+            tok[j] = None
+            k = nxt[j]
+            nxt[i] = k
+            if k >= 0:
+                prv[k] = i
+            merged.append(i)
+        for i in merged:
+            h = prv[i]
+            if h >= 0:
+                a = tok[h]
+                rr = merges_get((a, r))
+                if rr is not None:
+                    heappush(heap, (rr, h, a, r))
+            k = nxt[i]
+            if k >= 0:
+                b = tok[k]
+                rr = merges_get((r, b))
+                if rr is not None:
+                    heappush(heap, (rr, i, r, b))
+    return [t for t in tok if t is not None]
+
+# first two helper functions...
